opening: It happens every time I go from lying down to sitting up.
When I sat up here in the emergency department, I felt dizzy just before I passed out.
My vision went blurry just before I passed out.
I yawned just before I passed out.
I use salbutamol for my asthma.

opening.text: I keep passing out, and it's been happening for 10 days. It happens every time I go from lying down to sitting up. When I sat up here in the emergency department, I felt dizzy just before I passed out, my vision went blurry, and I yawned. I have asthma and I use salbutamol for it.
